label: TopicEmbedImport mutates caller's contents string in place
withdrawn_reason: Head failure is a NameError (uninitialized constant TopicEmbed::Nokogiri) at a later site; the claimed URI::InvalidURIError never fired on the recorded toolchain (ruby 2.6.10 accepts URI('http://') with empty host), and the fix's own guard manufactures the expected exception. The underlying line-anchored regex class may be real but is not demonstrated by this evidence. Validated 2026-09-18.
